name: Ezme
assumptions: Yield estimated at 4 servings based on typical Turkish meze/salad portion sizes for 4 people as a side or starter; original source implies shared dish but does not specify servings
Total active preparation time estimated at 20 minutes: ~10 min for chopping/blitzing in food processor, ~5-10 min for straining, whisking sauce, and combining; no cooking involved
All ingredients screened as compatible with listed diets; no animal products, no gluten sources, no dairy
Sesame left as null due to possible cross-contamination in commercial red pepper paste, pomegranate molasses, or shared processing equipment (ambiguous without specific labels)
Pomegranate molasses classified conservatively as vegan/vegetarian (fruit-based, no added animal ingredients assumed)
Red pepper paste (biber salcasi) assumed free of wheat/gluten and animal products based on typical Turkish varieties
No explicit compound sauces listed that would introduce ambiguity beyond noted items
instructions:
step 1
Put the tomatoes and all of the peppers in a food processor and blitz until finely chopped. Tip out into a sieve, set over a bowl and leave to strain. Add the onions, garlic and parsley to the food processor and blitz until finely chopped, then set aside.

step 2
Add red pepper paste, tomato purée, pomegranate molasses, pul biber, sumac, dried mint and most of the extra virgin olive oil to a serving bowl and whisk well so everything comes together as a sauce. Tip in the blitzed onion mixture and the strained pepper mixture along with 1 tsp flaky sea salt . Stir well, then drizzle with the remaining extra virgin olive oil to serve.

ingredients.name: Tomato
ingredients.assumptions: 3 large tomatoes ≈ 450g total; typical medium-large tomato is 150g; raw, edible portion only

ingredients.name: Romano Pepper
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium Romano (sweet red) pepper ≈ 120g; raw, edible portion after deseeding

ingredients.name: Green Chilli
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium green chilli ≈ 20g; raw, edible portion

ingredients.name: Parsley
ingredients.assumptions: Exactly 25g fresh parsley as listed; raw, edible leaves and stems

ingredients.name: Red Pepper Paste
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tablespoons Turkish red pepper paste (biber salcasi) ≈ 30g; typical density and commercial product values

ingredients.name: Tomato Puree
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tablespoon tomato puree/paste ≈ 15g; standard commercial value

ingredients.name: Pomegranate Molasses
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tablespoons pomegranate molasses ≈ 30g; typical commercial product, high-sugar syrup

ingredients.name: Pul Biber
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tablespoon pul biber (Aleppo pepper flakes) ≈ 6g; standard spice density

ingredients.name: Sumac
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tsp sumac ≈ 4g; typical spice values yield negligible macros per small quantity

ingredients.name: Dried Mint
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tablespoon dried mint ≈ 3g; standard dried herb density

ingredients.name: Extra Virgin Olive Oil
ingredients.assumptions: 60 ml extra virgin olive oil ≈ 55g (density 0.91 g/ml); entire amount used in recipe
